ASININE:
(1) by comp.;
(2) गर्दमीयः (या, यं):
v. Also stupid.

ASSIGN:
I To appoint, allot:
(1) दिशति,
 निर्दिशति (दिश्, c. 6.);
(2) कल्पयति, उप-, प्र-,
(कॢप्, c. 10.)
and should a. lands for his main-
tenance
भूम्यन्तरञ्च तद्वृत्त्यर्थमुपकल्पयेत्, K. b.
II
To allege: q. v.: निर्दिशति।
III To trans-
-fer property: समर्पयति (c. of ऋ): v. To
bequeath.

ASSIGNATION:
I Assignment: q. v.
II An
engagement: सङ्केतः। A lady going to an a.
अभिसारिका।

ASSIGNMENT:
(1) दानम्;
(2) समर्पणम्: v. To
assign, allotment.

ASSIMILATE:
I To make like: सदृशीकरोति:
v. Like.
II To convert into blood: v.
To digest.

ASSIMILATION:
I A making like: सदृशीकरणम्।
II Of food: पाकः: v. Digestion.

ASSIST:
(1) साहाय्यं
or
साहाय्यकं
or
साहायकं करोति
(with gen.),
Sir, a. me in trouble
क्लिष्टस्य मे
 क्रियतामर्थसाहाय्यकम्, D. viii;
(2) उपकरोति।
(=do good in general).

ASSIZE:
I A court of justice: विचारसभा (?).
II Fixing the price of commodities: अर्थ-
संस्थापनम्,
the a. rate
संस्थापितमूल्यम्।
